title: Vanishing even majority coefficients
statement: Let $m\in\mathbb N$ and let $S\subseteq[2m+1]$ have even cardinality. For the majority function on $\{0,1\}^{2m+1}$, whose value is $1$ when more than $m$ coordinates are false and $-1$ otherwise, the Fourier--Walsh coefficient at $S$ is zero: $\widehat M_m(S)=0$.
replaced:
Let $m\in\mathbb N$, put $n=2m+1$, and define $M_m:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ by
$M_m(x)=1$ when more than $m$ coordinates equal $1$, and $M_m(x)=-1$ otherwise.
For $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ define
$\widehat M_m(S)=2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{\pm1\}^n}M_m(x)\prod_{i\in S}x_i$.
If $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ has even cardinality, then $\widehat M_m(S)=0$.
